title: Cactus on the shore.
lede: Cousteau is said to have called the Sea of Cortez the aquarium of the world. It’s a narrow gulf that concentrates what other oceans spread across thousands of miles: cold upwellings, uninhabited islands and a density of life that still surprises people who have sailed it for years. We sail from La Paz to the islands of Espíritu Santo, and from Loreto down to La Paz on longer expeditions.
